race.comment: PRECAMBRIAN (4) was in a rearwards position on the turn last time out before finishing 5 lengths from the winner in fifth over 1600m at Pakenham Synthetic. Rates highly in this field and can turn things around. THINKING POSITIVE (11) finished 5.5 lengths from the winner in fifth after being in the firing line on the turn at her most recent outing over 1500m at Bendigo. Worth including in this suitable contest. JULEP (8) is deep into the prep but beat home all bar a hot favourite last start so seems to be holding together nicely. UNDER CONTROL (12) takes a big step up in distance and should be ready to show more third-up
